title: 4DBInfer: A 4D Benchmarking Toolbox for Graph-Centric Predictive Modeling on Relational DBs
reasoning: The paper describes a benchmarking toolbox for machine learning on relational databases. It focuses on technical performance metrics (AUC, MRR, Accuracy, RMSE) and architectural designs (GNNs and tabular models) without any component related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
